parsed.rationale: Both participating records carry `is_test: true` — `iTunesArtworkServiceTests.SequentialMockSession` in `Shared/Artwork/Tests/ArtworkTests/ArtworkFetcherTests.swift` and `EntityResolverMockWebSession` in `Shared/Metadata/Tests/MetadataTests/DiscogsAPIEntityResolverCachingTests.swift`. These are test-local mock session helpers whose structural similarity (shared `requestedURLs:[URL]` field, parallel `responses` field) is incidental to their respective test fixtures. Lifting them into shared production or shared-test infrastructure would couple the `Artwork` and `Metadata` test targets unnecessarily, and the differing `responses` slot types (`[Data]` vs `[String: Data]`) indicate the two types serve meaningfully different stubbing contracts. The restraint rule for test fixtures dominates.
